e-4379.worked_solution:
First, we simplify the expression by distributing the subtraction over the matrices in the parentheses: 

$$
\begin{aligned}A+C-(B+A) & =A+C-B-A \\  & =\cancel{A}+C-B-\cancel{A} \\  & =C-B\end{aligned}
$$

$$

$$

\begin{aligned}(A+B)-C-(B-C) & =A+B-C-B+C \\  & =A+\cancel{B}-\cancel{C}-\cancel{B}+\cancel{C} \\  & =A\end{aligned}

decision.explanation: Distribute subtraction and cancel C: C+V-(N+C)=V-N. Subtracting corresponding entries gives (5-1, 3-(-7))=(4,10), (6-2, -4-(-6))=(4,2), and (-1-3, -8-5)=(-4,-13). This matches option b.

$$
\begin{aligned}C+V-(N+C) & =C+V-N-C \\  & =\cancel{C}+V-N-\cancel{C} \\  & =V-N\end{aligned}
$$

We are left with a single subtraction. So, we subtract the corresponding entries of the two matrices:

$$
\begin{aligned}V-N & =[\begin{aligned}5 & 3 \\ 6 & -4 \\ -1 & -8\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}1 & -7 \\ 2 & -6 \\ 3 & 5\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}5-1 & 3-(-7) \\ 6-2 & -4-(-6) \\ -1-3 & -8-5\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}4 & 10 \\ 4 & 2 \\ -4 & -13\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
